name: Tsuribito Tackle
description: Tsuribito Tackle — a WooCommerce store theme for a small harbour tackle shop, built as horizontal strips. A white top header carries the shop name, a Shop the tackle button, the account and cart, and a Menu button that opens a full-screen crimson overlay menu (numbered; vertical words in Chinese and Japanese). Crimson red (#C9171E) is the main colour: the strip across the hero's foot, the synced tide board, the tested-on-the-breakwater band, every page head and the footer strip are crimson fields. The hero is a full-bleed high-key photograph of a misty shore; a cut-out reel (transparent WebP) breaks out over the crimson strip and the photo edge, a cut-out red float breaks out of the shop photo and over the band's top edge, and over every page head. The shelf, the three waters, the promises and the tide notes are sideways scroll-snap strips. Every picture is a photorealistic high-key photograph. Kiwi Maru for display, Onest for reading. Sample content and products in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-25 (horizontal-strip, full-bleed-illustration hero, overlay nav, real-photography, high-key, beni crimson #C9171E, Kiwi Maru + Onest, fishing tackle shop in shops-hobbies). A full top header (shop name, Shop the tackle button, account and cart) whose Menu button opens a full-screen crimson overlay menu at every width (numbered; vertical words in Chinese and Japanese). The full-bleed hero is a photograph, since the row's image treatment is real-photography: every picture is a photorealistic high-key photograph (85mm f/2.8, large softbox, near-white background, faint shadows, graded toward crimson) generated with Grok Build. Horizontal strips: the crimson hero strip, the tide board cells, the product shelf, the three waters, the promises and the tide notes run sideways with scroll-snap. Break-frame: the cut-out reel (transparent WebP) breaks out of the full-bleed hero photo, over the crimson strip at its foot and into the tide board below; the cut-out red float breaks out of the framed shop photo and over the top edge of the crimson breakwater band; the same float breaks over the bottom edge of every page head. Sample content and products in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de. Contrast: white #FFFFFF on crimson #C9171E 5.79:1 (all text on the hero strip, tide board, breakwater band, page heads, footer strip, menu overlay and buttons); ink #1C1416 on white 18.1:1 (body text, hero type over the high-key photo's white sky); deep crimson #9E1117 on white 8.25:1 and on mist #F6F1F1 7.37:1 (links, prices, labels); wet stone #5F5658 on white 7.1:1 and on mist 6.34:1 (secondary text); white on ink 18.1:1 and pale red #F4B9BB on ink 10.8:1 (footer); crimson on white 5.79:1 (marks); ink on crimson only 3.1:1, never used for text.

summary.zh-TW: 緋紅色的港邊釣具店：滿版高調攝影主視覺、去背捲線器衝出畫面，橫向滑動的貨架與潮汐看板；全螢幕選單，樣本內容含五種語言。
summary.en: A crimson harbour tackle shop: a full-bleed high-key shore photo, a cut-out reel breaking out, and sideways shelves.
summary.ja: 緋色の港の釣具店。全面のハイキー写真、枠を飛び出す切り抜きのリール、横にスクロールする棚と潮の黒板。五か国語のサンプル付き。
summary.fr: Une boutique de pêche cramoisie : photo high-key pleine largeur, moulinet détouré qui déborde, étagères qui défilent.
summary.de: Ein karminroter Angelladen am Hafen: randloses High-Key-Foto, freigestellte Rolle, die herausragt, seitlich scrollende Regale.
